method.policy: Public-state heuristic: one best adjacent attack per month at 1.5x target troops adjusted by castle terrain, retain 400 garrison; recruit border to 2200 with order>=60 and 18-month food cover, fortify border to 60, commerce/farm to 65. Infantry only. Before attacks, transfer 100 infantry and food to adjacent friendly castles short of maintenance through the next September harvest; donor keeps the same maintenance cover and at least one other officer. At most one donor per target per month, ledger accounts for queued incoming/outgoing food. No diplomatic orders, hires, event choices or manual tactics. Existing auto combat. Not a human playtest or optimum strategy.
